commit 97aa3c10da3f35e9dab3470bb5cafff567b106a3
Author: Ma, Guokai <guokai.ma@gmail.com>
Date:   Thu Nov 19 03:29:21 2026 +0000

    feat(rollout): segment-based kernel injection for hybrid-engine greedy decode (#8602)
    
    ## Summary
    
    Adds a **segment-KI framework** that accelerates greedy decode in the
    hybrid-engine rollout by injecting native CUDA kernels into comm-free
    segments of the model, plus a **C++ decode loop** that runs the full
    autoregressive generation with near-zero per-step Python overhead.
    
    ### Segment detection: structural, not per-model
    
    Detection is attribute-name based: any HF family whose gated MLP uses
    `gate_proj/up_proj/down_proj` (LLaMA, Qwen, Mistral, DeepSeek, Gemma...)
    or whose GatedDeltaNet block uses the `in_proj_{qkv,z,b,a}` set is
    picked up without per-model code. Projections carrying TP collectives
    are never fused (a defensive `isinstance` check against the Allreduce
    layer hierarchy).
    
    ### Co-location by construction
    
    Both GLU (dual-weight GEMV) and GDN (quad-weight GEMV) replacements read
    the original weight Parameters directly through `autograd.Function`s
    with exact backward, so training and generation share one forward path:
    **zero weight copies, no inject/eject switching between rollout and
    training**. Verified end-to-end by an integration test (below): generate
    → train one step → generate, output changes, no sync calls.
    
    ## Components
    
    | File | Role |
    |---|---|
    | `csrc/module_inject/fused_glu.cu` | dual/quad-weight GEMV (MLP / GDN
    input projections), GDN gates, decode attention (warp-per-head, KV
    split-K, online softmax), fused residual+RMSNorm, triple QKV GEMV,
    graph-capturable decode step |

diff --git a/deepspeed/__init__.py b/deepspeed/__init__.py
index 4be7295b4..b4389f54f 100755
--- a/deepspeed/__init__.py
+++ b/deepspeed/__init__.py
@@ -430,6 +430,13 @@ def resolve_per_head_muon_after_sharding(model: torch.nn.Module) -> None:
     logger.info("per_head_muon: after sharding, tagged %s", dict(sorted(tagged.items())))
 
 
+def _autosp_sequence_parallel_size(config):
+    passes = config.get("compile", {}).get("passes", None) or []
+    if "autosp" not in passes:
+        return 1
+    return config.get("sequence_parallel_size", 1)
+
+
 def initialize(
     args: Any = None,
     model: torch.nn.Module = None,
@@ -534,6 +541,20 @@ def initialize(
     if not isinstance(config, dict):
         config = load_ds_config(config)
 
+    if _autosp_sequence_parallel_size(config) > 1:
+        # Without the AutoSP backend each rank trains on its full sequence, while the engine still sums
+        # gradients over the sequence parallel ranks. Only DeepCompile runs that backend, and not with ZeRO 2/3.
+        if not config.get("compile", {}).get("deepcompile", False):
+            raise ValueError("AutoSP requires DeepCompile; set compile.deepcompile to true")
+        zero_config = config.get("zero_optimization", {})
+        if isinstance(zero_config, bool):
+            # The deprecated boolean form selects stage 1 or 0.
+            zero_stage = int(zero_config)
+        else:
+            zero_stage = zero_config.get("stage", 0)
+        if zero_stage >= 2:
+            raise ValueError(f"AutoSP does not support ZeRO stage {zero_stage}; use ZeRO stage 0 or 1")
+
     mesh_device = None
     if mesh_param:
         logger.info(f"mesh_param to Initialize mesh device: {mesh_param}")
@@ -544,6 +565,15 @@ def initialize(
             logger.info(f"config to Initialize mesh device: {config}")
             mesh_device = dist.initialize_mesh_device((config["data_parallel_size"], config["sequence_parallel_size"]), \
             ("data_parallel", "sequence_parallel"))
+        elif mpu is None and _autosp_sequence_parallel_size(config) > 1:
+            # AutoSP shards the sequence inside the compiled graph, but the engine still needs the sequence
+            # parallel dimension to sum gradients over SP ranks while averaging them over DP ranks.
+            sp_size = _autosp_sequence_parallel_size(config)
+            if dist.get_world_size() % sp_size != 0:
+                raise ValueError(f"world size {dist.get_world_size()} is not divisible by "
+                                 f"sequence_parallel_size {sp_size}")
+            mesh_device = dist.initialize_mesh_device((dist.get_world_size() // sp_size, sp_size),
+                                                      ("data_parallel", "sequence_parallel"))
 
     merge_tp_model_init_into_config(config, mpu, mesh_param, dist)

commit d70adc325caa4c5d4e3fcebe19abbdbe41638a2e
Author: Zhipeng Wang <zhipeng.rainbowserie@gmail.com>
Date:   Fri Nov 20 18:07:03 2026 +0000

    [AutoEP] Stage expert weight gradients across microbatches (#9114)
    
    Implements the proposal in #9113: an opt-in AutoEP mode that stages the
    rows of the experts' weight-gradient GEMMs across microbatches and runs
    those GEMMs once per several backward passes.
    
    This PR was written with AI assistance (Claude Code). I have reviewed
    all of the code line by line and signed off each commit.
    
    ## What changes
    
    - `deepspeed/moe/ep_experts.py`: new `MoeDeferredDwStaging` (per-expert
    staging buffers and cursors; gradients are returned by one backward in
    every period and by the backward that closes an accumulation window; a
    full buffer runs the GEMMs early and holds the result until then).
    `_DeferredWeightGradExperts` and `GroupedExperts.forward` take an
    optional staging object. The dW products are factored into
    `_grouped_mlp_weight_grads`, shared by the immediate, slot and staged
    paths.
    - `deepspeed/module_inject/auto_ep_layer.py`, `auto_ep_config.py`,
    `auto_ep_presets/base.py`: `deferred_dw_flush_period` and
    `deferred_dw_rows_per_expert`, validation, and passing the staging
    object (and unpadded per-expert counts) at the three `self.experts(...)`
    call sites.
    - `deepspeed/runtime/engine.py` (core, wiring only): mark the backward
    that closes an accumulation window so it flushes; refuse an optimizer
    step with rows still staged; reject unmanaged accumulation, ZenFlow and
    DeepCompile.
    - `deepspeed/runtime/zero/stage_1_and_2.py` (core, 4 lines): the
    gradient hook fires even when the backward delivered no gradient for a
    parameter in the graph;
====

Author: Han Yu <helloyu0903@gmail.com>
Date:   Sun Nov 15 00:10:52 2026 +0000

    Overlap AutoEP's expert weight gradients with the DeepEP backward combine (#8739)

Author: Xinyu Lian <lian7@illinois.edu>
Date:   Fri Nov 20 19:58:13 2026 +0000

    ZeRO-3 partial offload: fix LR schedules and checkpoints of the device sub-groups (#8973)
    
    ## Summary
    
    With `offload_optimizer.ratio` < 1, ZeRO-3 keeps some sub-groups on the
    device and steps them with a separate torch
    optimizer (`backup_optimizer`). That optimizer has several bugs that
    change the training result without an error.
    SuperOffload uses the same optimizer for its device sub-groups; the rest
    of SuperOffload is fixed in #8972.
    
    ## Fixes
    
    1. The device sub-groups ignored LR schedules and `set_lr()`, and
    changes of `betas`, `eps` and `weight_decay`. Ina
    first step at lr 0, the weights moved by 3.0e-3. The backup optimizer
    now copies these values before each step.
    2. Checkpoints had no Adam state for the device sub-groups (a resume was
    4.9e-3 off after one step). It is now saved
    with the state of the CPU sub-groups: a resume is bit-identical, and a
    checkpoint loads with another `ratio`.
    3. After a checkpoint load, every device step also updated the CPU
    sub-groups of param groups 1 and up, because their
    dicts were shared with the main optimizer (3.0e-3 extra per step at lr
    3e-3). Each param group of the backup
       optimizer now has its own dict.
    4. `safe_get_full_optimizer_state` and `safe_set_full_optimizer_state`
    raised `KeyError` for the device sub-groups, and
       `ds_to_universal` raised `KeyError: 0`. Both work now.
    5. With `adam_w_mode: false`, the device sub-groups used decoupled
    weight decay (2.4e-2 off after 4 steps); they now use
    `torch.optim.Adam` (L2). `bias_correction: false` with `ratio` < 1 now
    raises a `ValueError`.
    
    ---------
    
    Signed-off-by: Xinyu Lian <lian7@illinois.edu>

commit daf175b1133e6c3ebb11cd415c006ce6b0c7b181
Author: Xinyu Lian <lian7@illinois.edu>
Date:   Wed Nov 18 09:06:45 2026 +0000

    ZeRO-3: fix stale and lost gradients of unused parameters (#8981)
    
    ## Summary
    
    ZeRO-3 keeps each param's gradient partition across steps and overwrites
    it only in micro-step 0. A param that
    gets no gradient in a step (a skipped branch, an unused expert)
    therefore keeps its last gradient, and the optimizer
    applies it again; ZeRO-1/2 give it a zero gradient. With this PR, a
    param's first gradient after `step()` or
    `zero_grad()` overwrites its partition. At the accumulation boundary,
    the partitions that got no gradient are
    zeroed, and with optimizer offload, every partition the optimizer has
    not received yet is copied to it.
    
      ## Fixes
    
      Before → after, 1 rank on GH200 (base `2d80cedd2`):
    
    1. A param without a gradient in a step was updated again with its last
    gradient (SGD, largest weight change:
         2.358e-02 → 0).
    2. With gradient accumulation, a param first used after micro-step 0
    added its gradient to the previous step's.
    3. With optimizer offload, the gradient of a param used only in earlier
    micro-steps never reached the optimizer
         (norm 0 → 0.17340).
    4. With fp16, an inf left in an unused param's partition made every
    later step overflow (skipped steps: 5 → 1 of
      5).
    5. A param used by two reentrant checkpoint segments kept one of its two
    gradients if they were in different
      buckets
         (2 ranks, norm 0.10933 → 0.27053).
    
    ---------
====
commit 54c40311be174aba39cba8518b67284b582f411b
Author: Xinyu Lian <lian7@illinois.edu>
Date:   Tue Nov 17 09:44:29 2026 +0000

    ZeRO-3 NVMe offload: give swapped-out parameter partitions the model dtype (#9099)
    
    Fixes #9095. Since #8843, ZeRO-3 with NVMe parameter offload fails in
    `deepspeed.initialize` for bf16 and fp32 models:
    
    ```
    NotImplementedError: ZeRO-3 parameter offload keeps parameter partitions in one dtype; found [torch.bfloat16, torch.float16]
    ```
    
    A partition swapped out to NVMe keeps a 1-element placeholder as
    `ds_tensor`, and the swapper made that placeholder fp16 for every model
    dtype. #8843 reads `ds_tensor.dtype` at init. The partitions on NVMe
    then report fp16 while the small ones kept in CPU memory report bf16, so
    they look like two dtypes. Now the placeholder takes the swapper's
    dtype, which every swap buffer already has. fp16 models are unchanged.
    The PR also adds an fp32 variant of `test_param_and_optimizer`, since
    the existing tests use bf16 only.
    
    ---------
    
    Signed-off-by: Xinyu Lian <lian7@illinois.edu>

    ZeRO-3 partial offload: fix LR schedules and checkpoints of the device sub-groups (#8973)
    
    ## Summary
    
    With `offload_optimizer.ratio` < 1, ZeRO-3 keeps some sub-groups on the
    device and steps them with a separate torch
    optimizer (`backup_optimizer`). That optimizer has several bugs that
    change the training result without an error.
    SuperOffload uses the same optimizer for its device sub-groups; the rest
    of SuperOffload is fixed in #8972.
    
    ## Fixes
    
    1. The device sub-groups ignored LR schedules and `set_lr()`, and
    changes of `betas`, `eps` and `weight_decay`. Ina
    first step at lr 0, the weights moved by 3.0e-3. The backup optimizer
    now copies these values before each step.
    2. Checkpoints had no Adam state for the device sub-groups (a resume was
    4.9e-3 off after one step). It is now saved
    with the state of the CPU sub-groups: a resume is bit-identical, and a
    checkpoint loads with another `ratio`.
    3. After a checkpoint load, every device step also updated the CPU
    sub-groups of param groups 1 and up, because their
    dicts were shared with the main optimizer (3.0e-3 extra per step at lr
    3e-3). Each param group of the backup
       optimizer now has its own dict.
    4. `safe_get_full_optimizer_state` and `safe_set_full_optimizer_state`
    raised `KeyError` for the device sub-groups, and
       `ds_to_universal` raised `KeyError: 0`. Both work now.
    5. With `adam_w_mode: false`, the device sub-groups used decoupled
    weight decay (2.4e-2 off after 4 steps); they now use
    `torch.optim.Adam` (L2). `bias_correction: false` with `ratio` < 1 now
    raises a `ValueError`.
    
    ---------
    
    Signed-off-by: Xinyu Lian <lian7@illinois.edu>

Author: Xinyu Lian <lian7@illinois.edu>

    ZeRO-3: fix stale and lost gradients of unused parameters (#8981)
    
    ## Summary
    
    ZeRO-3 keeps each param's gradient partition across steps and overwrites
    it only in micro-step 0. A param that
    gets no gradient in a step (a skipped branch, an unused expert)
    therefore keeps its last gradient, and the optimizer
    applies it again; ZeRO-1/2 give it a zero gradient. With this PR, a
    param's first gradient after `step()` or
    `zero_grad()` overwrites its partition. At the accumulation boundary,
    the partitions that got no gradient are
    zeroed, and with optimizer offload, every partition the optimizer has
    not received yet is copied to it.
    
      ## Fixes
    
      Before → after, 1 rank on GH200 (base `2d80cedd2`):
    
    1. A param without a gradient in a step was updated again with its last
    gradient (SGD, largest weight change:
         2.358e-02 → 0).
    2. With gradient accumulation, a param first used after micro-step 0
    added its gradient to the previous step's.
    3. With optimizer offload, the gradient of a param used only in earlier
    micro-steps never reached the optimizer
         (norm 0 → 0.17340).
    4. With fp16, an inf left in an unused param's partition made every
    later step overflow (skipped steps: 5 → 1 of
      5).
    5. A param used by two reentrant checkpoint segments kept one of its two
    gradients if they were in different
      buckets
         (2 ranks, norm 0.10933 → 0.27053).

    ZeRO-3 NVMe offload: give swapped-out parameter partitions the model dtype (#9099)
    
    Fixes #9095. Since #8843, ZeRO-3 with NVMe parameter offload fails in
    `deepspeed.initialize` for bf16 and fp32 models:
    
    ```
    NotImplementedError: ZeRO-3 parameter offload keeps parameter partitions in one dtype; found [torch.bfloat16, torch.float16]
    ```
    
    A partition swapped out to NVMe keeps a 1-element placeholder as
    `ds_tensor`, and the swapper made that placeholder fp16 for every model
    dtype. #8843 reads `ds_tensor.dtype` at init. The partitions on NVMe
    then report fp16 while the small ones kept in CPU memory report bf16, so
    they look like two dtypes. Now the placeholder takes the swapper's
    dtype, which every swap buffer already has. fp16 models are unchanged.
    The PR also adds an fp32 variant of `test_param_and_optimizer`, since
    the existing tests use bf16 only.

Author: Ma, Guokai <guokai.ma@gmail.com>
Date:   Sun Nov 15 05:21:27 2026 +0000

    [Hybrid Engine] Enable XPU graph capture behind the explicit opt-in (#9007)
    
    Follow-up to #8980. Wire the XPU accelerator into the explicit
    graph-capture opt-in that #8980 introduces.
    
    ## Background
    
    `XPU_Accelerator` currently stubs the graph interfaces: `create_graph()`
    returns `None`, capture is a no-op context, and replay does nothing, so
    HybridEngine always runs eager on XPU. Upstream PyTorch ships XPU stream
    capture since 2.11 (`torch.xpu.XPUGraph`, the `torch.xpu.graph` capture
    context, and `torch.xpu.is_current_stream_capturing()`), so the
    capability exists but was never connected. Note #8980 does not regress
    XPU — it opts XPU out of a path that was never functional — this PR
    turns the real support on.

    Aggregates the AutoSP causal-LM loss and gradients over the
    sequence-parallel group, so training matches the full sequence.
    
    This PR now covers only loss and gradient aggregation. Label alignment
    for a causal shift *inside* the model (tohtana's `sp_compile.py`
    comment) moves to a follow-up draft PR. Until that lands, labels must be
    shifted on the full sequence before `prepare_autosp_inputs()`.

Author: Venus-Tzz <1601677496@qq.com>
Date:   Sat Nov 21 07:08:14 2026 +0000

    Fix AutoTP multi-query GPTBigCode training at TP > 1 (#8962)
    
    Fixes #8961.
    
    ## Scope
    
    This PR fixes the empty attention shard, the non-contiguous K/V
    gradient, and the post-accumulate hook rescaling earlier micro-batches
    under gradient accumulation in AutoTP multi-query GPTBigCode at TP > 1.
    Parity tests use `gradient_clipping: 0.0`; the default clipping path is
    a separate pre-existing issue.
    
    The branch now contains only the four correctness commits (head
    `1a19b1aab`). The deferred-reduce optimization discussed in review was
    split into follow-up PR #9064 (branch `fix-gptbigcode-autotp-defer-kv`,
    2 commits, stacked on this one); this PR is correctness-only and should
    merge first.
    
    ## Background
    
    GPTBigCode's fused `c_attn` stores the query rows followed by the whole
    shared K/V block. With transformers 5.x, `num_key_value_heads=1` makes
    AutoTP create empty query shards at TP > 1; some backends also return a
    non-contiguous K/V gradient, and torch_npu skipped the plain hook under
    ZeRO 1/2. A post-accumulate fallback is needed there, but it must not
    reduce the already accumulated K/V gradient again on the next
=====
commit 892ed83e417df01d9d4f21f559a0b88183cf5e4c
Author: Masahiro Tanaka <81312776+tohtana@users.noreply.github.com>
Date:   Sat Nov 14 16:11:41 2026 +0000

    Stabilize FPDT logits loss for extreme finite logits (#9068)
    
    `FPDT_LogitsLoss` computes negative log-likelihood from
    `softmax(...).log()`.
    
    For finite FP32 logits such as `[-1000, 1000]` with target 0, the target
    probability underflows to zero and the token loss becomes `+inf`,
    although the representable reference loss is approximately 2000. A zero
    reducer weight can then turn that value into `NaN` through `inf * 0`.
    
=====
commit 7454d78d53bfbf95ae66b660beed1821c209c7d8
Author: 0z5a <dezhen.lu@student.uni-tuebingen.de>
Date:   Tue Nov 17 10:52:34 2026 +0000

    [ops] Warn when DeepSpeedCPUAdam is limited to one OpenMP thread (#8938)
    
    torchrun sets `OMP_NUM_THREADS=1` for every process when
    `--nproc_per_node` is larger than 1, unless the variable is already set.
    `DeepSpeedCPUAdam` then steps on a single OpenMP thread, and nothing in
    the log says so. The deepspeed launcher sets the thread count only with
    `--bind_cores_to_rank`, which is the path the ZeRO-Offload tutorial
    documents. Users who launch with torchrun or accelerate get no hint.
    
    **Measured effect**

    Forward the per-head Muon tag at every muon_update call site (#8612)
    
    Per-head Muon (#8384) is silently ignored on three of the six paths that
    call `muon_update`, so the attention projections it tags are
    orthogonalized whole.
    
    `deepspeed.initialize` tags each attention projection with
    `muon_num_heads` and the call sites read it back off the parameter.
    Three do not: the padded branch of ZeRO 1/2 `get_flat_partition` (its
    unpadded twin does), `MuonWithAuxAdam.step`, and the new BF16_Optimizer
    Muon support. The padded branch runs when
    `zero_optimization.parameter_alignment` is on and a parameter's size is
    off the alignment, so whether the feature takes effect turns on an
    unrelated setting, and the update stays finite either way. Forward
    `num_heads` at all three.

    Forward the per-head Muon tag at every muon_update call site (#8612)
    
    Per-head Muon (#8384) is silently ignored on three of the six paths that
    call `muon_update`, so the attention projections it tags are
    orthogonalized whole.
    
    `deepspeed.initialize` tags each attention projection with
    `muon_num_heads` and the call sites read it back off the parameter.
    Three do not: the padded branch of ZeRO 1/2 `get_flat_partition` (its
    unpadded twin does), `MuonWithAuxAdam.step`, and the new BF16_Optimizer
    Muon support. The padded branch runs when
    `zero_optimization.parameter_alignment` is on and a parameter's size is
    off the alignment, so whether the feature takes effect turns on an
    unrelated setting, and the update stays finite either way. Forward
    `num_heads` at all three.
    
    Test: `TORCHDYNAMO_DISABLE=1 DS_ACCELERATOR=cpu PYTHONPATH=.:tests
    python -m pytest tests/unit/runtime/zero/test_per_head_muon.py -q`. The

input.rationale: 增量更新（663de973 -> 7681845b3，共 35 个提交，version.txt 仍为 0.20.1）：九单元主线结构与讲义顺序不变，本周期四条主线催生 3 篇新讲义。一是推理/rollout 主线：#8602 的 Segment-KI 段式内核注入（segment_ki.py 检测无通信段并注入原生 CUDA 内核、kernel_reference.py 纯 PyTorch 可执行规格、csrc/module_inject/fused_glu.cu 双/四权重 GEMV 与 decode attention、混合槽静态 cache、分层回退 decode 循环，训练与生成零权重拷贝共享同一前向）体量近 5000 行，拆出新讲义 u7-l5；#8997 的 TP=2 one-shot P2P 自定义 all-reduce（custom_collective 内核/拓扑门控/算子构建器，填充 inference_all_reduce 钩子）拆出 u3-l5；#8786 可调成本模型的 bucket 选择、#9127 静态图 decode 回归修复与 #9007 XPU 图捕获 opt-in 落在 u7-l4 与 u3-l1/u3-l2（update）。二是 AutoEP 专家权重梯度调度三连：#8739 overlap_weight_grad 把 dW GEMM 与 DeepEP combine 并行、#8745 opt-in 跳过重算段的 combine、#9114 跨微批 deferred dW staging 配套引擎侧 flush 标记与拒绝步语义，自成体系拆出 u6-l9，u6-l6 与 u2-l4 相应 update。三是 ZeRO 修复潮：#8973 partial offload 设备子组 backup_optimizer 的 LR/超参同步、检查点与状态工具修复，#8981 未用参数的陈旧/丢失梯度，#9099 NVMe 占位符 dtype，#8612/#8552 Muon per-head 转发与卷积形状，落在 u5-l6/u5-l8/u5-l9（update）；ZeRO-1/2 侧 #9016 offload_states 的 optim_fragment 视图重链与 #9114 无梯度也触发的梯度 hook 落在 u5-l3，#8938 CPUAdam 单 OpenMP 线程告警落在 u5-l4。四是 AffineIR 收官：#9011/#9039 把持有者与目标区域校验换成扫描，#9070 允许按参数自有 strides 的 flat shard，#9093 别名检查细化到实际搬动区域，#9027 暴露 schedule_transfers 公共调度报告 API，#8966 落地链路标定 calibrate_links/fit_links——u8-l7/u8-l9 update。其余：#8457/#8811 AutoSP 的 SP 组 loss/梯度聚合与 causal shift 目标对齐加 #9078 NCCL 头发现修复落在 u8-l4（含 u2-l1 的 initialize 前置校验），#9069/#8844 universal checkpoint 的 AutoTP 裸张量与 AutoEP 逐文件读取落在 u8-l3，#9085 Op Builder 重构落在 u1-l3/u9-l1，#8962 GPTBigCode 多查询修复落在 u6-l1，#9068 FPDT 损失稳定化落在 u6-l8，#8664 RMSNorm 窄行优化落在 u9-l2，CI 演进落在 u9-l4，u1-l2 代码地图补入新目录。无相关代码变化的讲义全部 keep。

lectures.topic: 解读 hybrid_engine.py 与 rollout 包：ZeRO-3 训练状态在训练/推理模式间切换权重布局支持 train-rollout 循环；图捕获按后端显式 opt-in（#9007 后 XPU 真实接入）、静态图 decode 掩码与采样、ZeRO-3 EOS 早停（#8390）与 AutoTP KV cache 惰性定尺寸（#9008）、连续图跨轮复用（#9009），以及本周期 #8786 的成本模型 bucket 路由与 #9127 的静态图 decode 回归修复。

learning_goals: 解释 #8602 Segment-KI 的定位：向模型的无集合通信段注入原生 CUDA 内核加速 hybrid-engine greedy decode，段检测是结构化而非逐模型的——按属性名识别 gate_proj/up_proj/down_proj 的 GLU 家族（LLaMA/Qwen/Mistral/DeepSeek/Gemma 等）与 in_proj_{qkv,z,b,a} 的 GatedDeltaNet 块，携带 TP 集合通信的投影绝不融合（对 Allreduce 层次做防御性 isinstance 检查）
理解「构造即共址」：GLU 双权重 GEMV 与 GDN 四权重 GEMV 替换经 autograd.Function（DualWeightGluGEMV/GDNInputProj，backward 精确）直接读原始 weight Parameter——零权重拷贝、训练与生成共享同一前向，rollout 与训练之间没有 inject/eject 切换

阅读 csrc/module_inject/fused_glu.cu 的内核族：dual/quad GEMV、GDN gates、decode attention（warp-per-head、KV split-K、online softmax）、fused residual+RMSNorm、triple QKV GEMV 与可图捕获的 decode step（C++ decode 循环以每 16 步一次的 D2H 同步检查 EOS 摊薄同步开销）
解读 kernel_reference.py 的角色：每个内核的纯 PyTorch 可执行规格，同时充当测试 oracle、运行时回退与 SYCL/XPU 移植参考；deepspeed/ops/module_inject 与 op_builder/fused_glu.py 走标准 JIT 装载
解读 static_cache.py 的混合槽静态 cache：全注意力层用真静态 KV 层，线性注意力（GDN）层用按引用复用 HF cudagraph-safe 状态缓冲的 pass-through 槽

追踪 rollout 接线：use_segki 开关注入 apply_segment_ki，prefill -> cache setup -> 图捕获 -> 分层回退 decode（b=1 full-step graph > b>1 graph+argmax > C++ 循环 > Python 循环）；segki_refresh 处理权重同步契约；#9127 修复其引入的静态图回归（见 u7-l4）；性能参考 Qwen3.5-4B/RTX 4080 SUPER/b=1 达 HF eager 的 3.1 倍

units.title: 内核工程、前沿方向与二次开发

call_5fc0932ecd5a4d5a84a15e40.head: 7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237
call_5fc0932ecd5a4d5a84a15e40.rationale: 增量更新（663de973 -> 7681845b3，共 35 个提交，version.txt 仍为 0.20.1）：九单元主线结构与讲义顺序不变，本周期四条主线催生 3 篇新讲义。一是推理/rollout 主线：#8602 的 Segment-KI 段式内核注入（segment_ki.py 检测无通信段并注入原生 CUDA 内核、kernel_reference.py 纯 PyTorch 可执行规格、csrc/module_inject/fused_glu.cu 双/四权重 GEMV 与 decode attention、混合槽静态 cache、分层回退 decode 循环，训练与生成零权重拷贝共享同一前向）体量近 5000 行，拆出新讲义 u7-l5；#8997 的 TP=2 one-shot P2P 自定义 all-reduce（custom_collective 内核/拓扑门控/算子构建器，填充 inference_all_reduce 钩子）拆出 u3-l5；#8786 可调成本模型的 bucket 选择、#9127 静态图 decode 回归修复与 #9007 XPU 图捕获 opt-in 落在 u7-l4 与 u3-l1/u3-l2（update）。二是 AutoEP 专家权重梯度调度三连：#8739 overlap_weight_grad 把 dW GEMM 与 DeepEP combine 并行、#8745 opt-in 跳过重算段的 combine、#9114 跨微批 deferred dW staging 配套引擎侧 flush 标记与拒绝步语义，自成体系拆出 u6-l9，u6-l6 与 u2-l4 相应 update。三是 ZeRO 修复潮：#8973 partial offload 设备子组 backup_optimizer 的 LR/超参同步、检查点与状态工具修复，#8981 未用参数的陈旧/丢失梯度，#9099 NVMe 占位符 dtype，#8612/#8552 Muon per-head 转发与卷积形状，落在 u5-l6/u5-l8/u5-l9（update）；ZeRO-1/2 侧 #9016 offload_states 的 optim_fragment 视图重链与 #9114 无梯度也触发的梯度 hook 落在 u5-l3，#8938 CPUAdam 单 OpenMP 线程告警落在 u5-l4。四是 AffineIR 收官：#9011/#9039 把持有者与目标区域校验换成扫描，#9070 允许按参数自有 strides 的 flat shard，#9093 别名检查细化到实际搬动区域，#9027 暴露 schedule_transfers 公共调度报告 API，#8966 落地链路标定 calibrate_links/fit_links——u8-l7/u8-l9 update。其余：#8457/#8811 AutoSP 的 SP 组 loss/梯度聚合与 causal shift 目标对齐加 #9078 NCCL 头发现修复落在 u8-l4（含 u2-l1 的 initialize 前置校验），#9069/#8844 universal checkpoint 的 AutoTP 裸张量与 AutoEP 逐文件读取落在 u8-l3，#9085 Op Builder 重构落在 u1-l3/u9-l1，#8962 GPTBigCode 多查询修复落在 u6-l1，#9068 FPDT 损失稳定化落在 u6-l8，#8664 RMSNorm 窄行优化落在 u9-l2，CI 演进落在 u9-l4，u1-l2 代码地图补入新目录。无相关代码变化的讲义全部 keep。

units.title: 内核工程、前沿方向与二次开发

data.head: 7681845b3e20b371e28f1affe6cd6b813f1aa237
data.rationale: 增量更新（663de973 -> 7681845b3，共 35 个提交，version.txt 仍为 0.20.1）：九单元主线结构与讲义顺序不变，本周期四条主线催生 3 篇新讲义。一是推理/rollout 主线：#8602 的 Segment-KI 段式内核注入（segment_ki.py 检测无通信段并注入原生 CUDA 内核、kernel_reference.py 纯 PyTorch 可执行规格、csrc/module_inject/fused_glu.cu 双/四权重 GEMV 与 decode attention、混合槽静态 cache、分层回退 decode 循环，训练与生成零权重拷贝共享同一前向）体量近 5000 行，拆出新讲义 u7-l5；#8997 的 TP=2 one-shot P2P 自定义 all-reduce（custom_collective 内核/拓扑门控/算子构建器，填充 inference_all_reduce 钩子）拆出 u3-l5；#8786 可调成本模型的 bucket 选择、#9127 静态图 decode 回归修复与 #9007 XPU 图捕获 opt-in 落在 u7-l4 与 u3-l1/u3-l2（update）。二是 AutoEP 专家权重梯度调度三连：#8739 overlap_weight_grad 把 dW GEMM 与 DeepEP combine 并行、#8745 opt-in 跳过重算段的 combine、#9114 跨微批 deferred dW staging 配套引擎侧 flush 标记与拒绝步语义，自成体系拆出 u6-l9，u6-l6 与 u2-l4 相应 update。三是 ZeRO 修复潮：#8973 partial offload 设备子组 backup_optimizer 的 LR/超参同步、检查点与状态工具修复，#8981 未用参数的陈旧/丢失梯度，#9099 NVMe 占位符 dtype，#8612/#8552 Muon per-head 转发与卷积形状，落在 u5-l6/u5-l8/u5-l9（update）；ZeRO-1/2 侧 #9016 offload_states 的 optim_fragment 视图重链与 #9114 无梯度也触发的梯度 hook 落在 u5-l3，#8938 CPUAdam 单 OpenMP 线程告警落在 u5-l4。四是 AffineIR 收官：#9011/#9039 把持有者与目标区域校验换成扫描，#9070 允许按参数自有 strides 的 flat shard，#9093 别名检查细化到实际搬动区域，#9027 暴露 schedule_transfers 公共调度报告 API，#8966 落地链路标定 calibrate_links/fit_links——u8-l7/u8-l9 update。其余：#8457/#8811 AutoSP 的 SP 组 loss/梯度聚合与 causal shift 目标对齐加 #9078 NCCL 头发现修复落在 u8-l4（含 u2-l1 的 initialize 前置校验），#9069/#8844 universal checkpoint 的 AutoTP 裸张量与 AutoEP 逐文件读取落在 u8-l3，#9085 Op Builder 重构落在 u1-l3/u9-l1，#8962 GPTBigCode 多查询修复落在 u6-l1，#9068 FPDT 损失稳定化落在 u6-l8，#8664 RMSNorm 窄行优化落在 u9-l2，CI 演进落在 u9-l4，u1-l2 代码地图补入新目录。无相关代码变化的讲义全部 keep。

掌握单机与多机（hostfile、include/exclude）两种启动写法

lectures.topic: 梳理 bin/deepspeed 启动器入口与 launch.py 的参数分发，以及 ds_report 如何探测环境。掌握单机/多机训练的启动方式，为后续实践任务打基础。

units.title: 初识 DeepSpeed：定位、构建与启动

参数 args 与 config 双通道

AutoEP staged 梯度的 flush 标记

lectures.title: 训练主循环：train_batch、backward 与 step

units.title: 核心用法：initialize 与训练引擎

XPU 的图捕获与 Level Zero pinned memory

lectures.title: 加速器抽象层：一套代码支持多种硬件

理解本周期 inference_all_reduce 钩子的填充（#8997）：TorchBackend.inference_all_reduce 在 world==2、P2P 可达、张量连续且不超过上限字节时改走 deepspeed.comm.custom_collective 的 one-shot 内核（与 CPU 后端的 shm+AVX 填同一个槽位），内核细节见 u3-l5

排查常见的多节点启动失败原因

lectures.topic: 阅读 runner.py 的 hostfile 解析、include/exclude 资源筛选与 multinode_runner 的远端命令拼装，理解从 deepspeed 命令到每个节点 python 训练脚本的完整链路。

learning_goals: 解释 #8997 的动机：TP=2 推理 decode 步要对小 hidden-state 张量做 all-reduce，NCCL 集合通信延迟占比高，one-shot P2P 内核用 CUDA IPC 缓冲（2x4MB、序列号 flag 握手）一次完成

lectures.title: TP=2 推理定制的 one-shot P2P all-reduce

learning_goals: 解读 #8739 的 overlap_weight_grad：GroupedExperts.forward 接受可选 ExpertWeightGradSlot，_DeferredWeightGradExperts 的 backward 立即返回 dX、把 dW GEMM（与 torch._grouped_mm 为 autograd 形成的 _grouped_mm_mat1/mat2_backward 相同的乘积）留在 slot；DeepEP dispatch 把专家权重作为额外输入，其 backward 先以 async_with_compute_stream=true 发起 combine，再在 compute stream 跑 slot 里的 dW GEMM，最后等 combine 事件——dW 经 autograd 正常返回，ZeRO 梯度处理不变；SM carveout 限制并发内核规模

解读 #9114 的跨微批 staging：MoeDeferredDwStaging 为每专家维护 staging 缓冲与游标（deferred_dw_flush_period/deferred_dw_rows_per_expert），把专家权重梯度 GEMM 的行拆到多个 backward、每若干次才跑一遍 GEMM；缓冲写满则提前跑 GEMM 并持有结果；dW 乘积被抽出为 _grouped_mlp_weight_grads 供 immediate/slot/staged 三路径共享

说明引擎侧契约（engine.py）：配置校验要求 managed_gradient_accumulation 并拒绝 ZenFlow/DeepCompile；backward 前把「关闭累积窗口」写入 dw_staging.flush_on_step；优化器 step 时若有 staged 行未 flush 直接拒绝；stage_1_and_2 的梯度 hook 在 backward 未产生某参数梯度时也触发
说明 auto_ep_config.py 的校验矩阵：overlap_weight_grad 需要 deepep 后端 + torch._grouped_mm 可用 + 不与 deferred/staged 组合，skip_recompute_combine 需要 reentrant 逐层检查点（docs/code-docs/source/autoep.rst 有完整契约章节）
